reasoning: 驗證目標：presets 瀏覽分類顯示中，清單可逐列捲動。關鍵情境條件：presets 數量多於單頁可顯示列數，否則捲動無從觀察。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 覆蓋單一操作的必然結果（每次操作前進一列、清單順序不變），依 §5.7 不拆分；與 017（逐頁）成同一清單互動能力的兩個分區，切分軸在兄弟 leaf 之間而非 TC 之間。刻意略過：清單首末端的 wrap-around 行為不在 4872422 文字內，且清單導覽的通用捲動規範屬 §1.3.10-1.3.12（List Navigation 批次，leaves 040-051），本 leaf 只驗 presets 瀏覽畫面支援逐列捲動。

tcs.tc_title: Presets browse list scrolls line by line
tcs.test_item: While the HU is displaying Presets browse categories, the HU shall allow line-by-line scrolling of the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. The number of presets on the list is larger than the number of lines displayed at one time
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Browse" on the Radio Playing page and open the presets browse category
2. Read the preset entries displayed and the position of the highlighted line
3. Request a line-by-line scroll down once
4. Read the preset entries displayed and the position of the highlighted line
5. Request a line-by-line scroll up once
tcs.expected_result:
1. The presets browse list is displayed
2. The first page of preset entries is displayed with the first line highlighted
3. The list advances by one line
4. The list is displayed one line further down, in unchanged preset-number order
5. The list returns to the previous line position
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
